title.justification: The paper's central focus is on the proposed framework of retrieval-enhanced machine learning (REML).
title.quote:
We describe a
generic retrieval-enhanced machine learning (REML) framework, which includes a number of existing models as special cases.

extractions.description: This paper presents a new framework called retrieval-enhanced machine learning (REML), which aims to improve machine learning models by integrating information retrieval techniques. The authors argue that current ML models rely heavily on increasing parameters for better performance, which is not sustainable. REML proposes using information retrieval to access large external knowledge bases to enhance model scalability, generalization, and interpretability. The paper discusses various approaches and challenges in implementing REML and suggests its potential applications across different domains.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on machine learning model enhancements without direct mention of climate or ecological sustainable development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We propose broadening the scope of users of information access systems to include task-driven machines, such as machine learning models.
